result.title: When Video Verifier Scores Mislead: Capability Assessment and Verifier Selection
result.summary: Video verifiers judge whether a candidate answer or trajectory agrees with a video, and are themselves chosen by a score. We show that this score depends on two choices in the test, the type of negative and the judgment interface, strongly enough to reverse conclusions about what a model can do and which verifier to deploy. We separate the two with controlled constructions that have exact truth conditions: endpoint-matched negatives, wrong only in their internal states, and a truth-switch test, in which the same two candidates swap correctness between two videos. Under direct judgment, where the verdict is read from answer scores, models that reject a visibly wrong start fall to near chance against endpoint-matched negatives. When the frames disclose each event, writing out reasoning before the answer lifts three of four models from under 10% to 70-100% on the truth-switch test, and staged inputs trace the direct failure to one step, composing events into states. But when the event must first be found, on human-validated natural video, the same change brings no significant gain under a protocol common to all models and can lower accuracy if one candidate denies that the event occurs. The negative type also changes which verifier is selected: one chosen on event-denial negatives is 8.9 points less accurate against negatives that keep the event and change a detail, the errors a generator mostly makes, and recovers about half as much accuracy when it reranks that generator's answers. A verifier should be evaluated on the errors it will face, and neither a low direct score nor a gain from reasoning should be read as a property of the model alone.

AI.brief_summary: 论文用 endpoint-matched negatives、truth-switch test 等受控构造加人类验证的自然视频，检验视频验证器的评分如何受负例类型与判断接口影响，并考察「先写推理再作答」能否挽回直接判分的失误，以及负例类型如何改变验证器选择。
AI.relevance_reason: 直接触及 THINK 收益取决于证据是否已被给出（帧披露事件时有增益、需先定位事件时无显著增益），与 LOOK/THINK 分工及「推理增益不属模型固有属性」的假设相关；验证器评分接口与负例偏差也提供了评价 latent 内容是否被使用的核查线索。
